title: hqb-unet-ablation: Source code for the parameter-matched ablation of a quantum-bottleneck U-Net
description: Source code of the manuscript “Does a Quantum Bottleneck Help a U-Net Segment Mammograms? Controlled Comparisons With Parameter-Matched Classical Layers”: the qseg package and all notebooks, scripts, prespecified protocols and statistical analyses (folder paper_v2), including experiment E3 (training on radiologist breast masks of VinDr-Mammo) and experiment W1 (faster-learning four-to-four mapping) with their protocols and aggregate results, and the supplementary document of the manuscript (docs/Supplementary_Material.pdf). No images, masks, weights or patient identifiers are included.
